words: Cottonwood series publish handler (DB-b-280). It reads the Cottonwood gold account_return_daily partitions from the floor day 2026-07-10 forward and never lists for reading or reads an earlier partition. It builds each account's series and manifest with publisher.py 0.2.0 (DB-b-279), including the unreported trading days and the null-preserving income array, and validates each against the series contract at the repo root before any write. A dry run is the default: it reads and builds and writes nothing. Only an event whose upload is exactly True writes, and then only the series and manifest of each account that builds, at the naming builder's platinum reporting address, followed by a head_object read-back of the stored series size. The summary carries counts and the unreported trading days; no account id is printed. NOT proven: that the handler has run against the real bucket, which is a pair-gated act; that the packaged Lambda layout resolves its sys.path lines; and that the publish Lambda's calendar source is not the hardcoded fallback.
